title.narrative: Women in Central Bougainville trained in chocolate making and cocoa value addition.

description.narrative:
The aim of this project is to add value to Bougainville’s cocoa industry by transitioning from the traditional export of raw dried beans to locally processed cocoa products, particularly chocolate. By introducing and equipping women in Central Bougainville with skills in chocolate making and cocoa-based product development, the project seeks to create alternative income-generating opportunities that are accessible at the household and community levels.
The key beneficiaries of this initiative are women cocoa farmers and processors in Central Bougainville, especially those who rely on smallholder cocoa farming as their main livelihood source. These women will gain practical knowledge in value-adding processes, including chocolate making, packaging, and marketing, allowing them to participate meaningfully in the broader cocoa value chain rather than remaining confined to the raw commodity level.
